context: A screenshot of ghent-live, a 3D map of the historic centre of Ghent (Belgium) rendered in a web browser at night, shown on a projector during a talk. The camera stands at eye height on a bridge over the river Leie (the Sint-Michielsbrug) and looks east into the city. The URL asks the 'Ask Ghent' panel where to park to reach the Gravensteen, a castle in the centre.

checks.name: panel_answers_parking
checks.instructions: The panel answers a parking question.

checks.instructions: Name labels 'Sint-Niklaas', 'Belfort' and 'Sint-Baafs' all show on the scene, none of them hidden behind the panel.
